title: User Management
description: Learn how to manage users, create accounts, assign roles, and control access to your Tijraa platform.
content:
User Management

Manage users, create accounts, assign roles, and control access to ensure the right people have the right permissions in your Tijraa account.

User Overview

View all users in your account:

  • User list with details
  • Search and filter users
  • View user activity
  • User status (active/inactive)

Creating Users

Step 1: Access User Management

Navigate to Users in your dashboard and click "Create User".

Step 2: Enter User Information

Fill in user details:

  • Full name
  • Email address
  • Password
  • Phone number (optional)

Step 3: Assign Role

Select a role for the user:

  • Super Admin
  • Admin
  • Manager
  • Staff
  • Custom roles

Step 4: Set Permissions

Assign specific permissions based on role or customize individually.

Step 5: Create User

Click "Create User". The user will receive an email invitation.

Managing Users

Manage existing users:

  • Edit user information
  • Change user roles
  • Update permissions
  • Reset passwords
  • Activate/deactivate users
  • Delete users

User Roles

Predefined roles:

  • Super Admin: Full access to everything
  • Admin: Administrative access
  • Manager: Management access
  • Staff: Limited access

Permissions

Granular permissions control:

  • View permissions
  • Create permissions
  • Edit permissions
  • Delete permissions
  • Manage permissions
  • Export permissions

User Activity

Monitor user activity:

  • Login history
  • Actions performed
  • Last login time
  • Activity logs

Best Practices

  • Use role-based access
  • Grant minimum necessary permissions
  • Review user access regularly
  • Deactivate unused accounts
  • Use strong passwords
  • Enable two-factor authentication
